evidence.snippet: a prior Series B of $12 million in February 2018 led by Sistema Asia Capital. By FY18 ending March 2019, HealthifyMe reported INR 24 crore in revenue, up significantly from INR 4 crore in FY17, driven by subscription pricing from INR 999 to 1,699 per month and improved monetization. The company had scaled to millions of users, with monthly revenues reaching INR 3 crore+ by mid-2018 and over 5 million lifetime users.
